baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic adventure photograph of an unmistakably adult East Asian woman treasure hunter, age 23, actively climbing a steep sunlit limestone cliff above a vast jungle valley. Preserve the reference image’s delicate oval face, large warm-brown eyes, pale skin, straight ash-silver bangs, and long high twin ponytails. She wears practical weathered expedition clothing: a fitted navy climbing jacket with ivory shoulder panels, rugged khaki trousers, harness, gloves, boots, and a compact leather satchel holding an antique map. One hand grips a narrow rock hold while the other reaches upward; her boots press against separate ledges and the safety rope pulls taut from her harness. Her focused, determined expression carries a hint of exhilaration. Frame her full body from a dramatic side-low angle, with windswept hair, chalk dust, textured rock, distant ruins, warm late-afternoon rim light, realistic skin, and crisp documentary detail.
